summary: Verified Heroku deployment fix: uv.lock is consistent with pyproject.toml. `uv lock --locked` exits 0 (resolved 49 packages, no update required). `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/uvtest_env uv sync --locked --no-default-groups` (Heroku's exact command) exits 0 and installs all 14 required runtime deps (fastapi 0.121.3, uvicorn 0.38.0, sqlalchemy 2.0.51, asyncpg 0.31.0, alembic 1.18.5, authlib 1.7.2, pyjwt 2.13.0, itsdangerous 2.2.0, psycopg2-binary 2.9.12, python-multipart 0.0.32, pypdf2 3.0.1, python-docx 1.2.0, python-pptx 1.0.2, pillow 12.3.0). Temp env cleaned up. .python-version=3.10, requires-python>=3.10 in pyproject.toml — consistent. Backend regression: 22/22 tests in test_monetization.py PASS. /api/health returns 200 ok. /api/auth/me without cookie returns 401 as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Heroku uv lockfile issue resolved. `uv lock --locked` and `uv sync --locked --no-default-groups` both exit 0. Full monetization regression suite (22 tests) green. Ready for Heroku deploy.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous uv.lock was out of sync with pyproject.toml (resolved on a different Python version, so Heroku's --locked check refused install). Regenerating uv.lock pinned to Python 3.10 (per .python-version) restored consistency; Heroku's `uv sync --locked --no-default-groups` now completes cleanly.
